title: Throughput–Integrity mapping for adaptive packing & KV expiry eval
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: produce a repeatable evaluation artefact that maps throughput/latency vs response integrity (fidelity) across a joint configuration space of adaptive request packing (microbatch sizing and packing interval) and KV cache expiry policies (TTL, prefix gluing behavior, and cold-hit priming). This ticket drives the design and implementation of the harness, the dataset/slice selection, metric definitions, and the dashboarding/alerting integration used by rollout and regression monitors. The aim is to provide a compact decision surface engineers can use to set safe defaults and automated rollbacks when config changes or model swaps are promoted to staging/production.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness exists that sweeps adaptive packing window sizes and packing delay thresholds together with KV cache TTLs and prefix merge settings
The harness runs across at least three representative models and two request-length distributions (short chat, long-form completion)
Define and compute a response-integrity score (combines semantic similarity to golden answers + hallucination / factuality heuristics) and a latency distribution summary (p50/p95/p99, tail count)
Produce a visualization that surfaces 2D tradeoffs (packing x TTL) with overlaid cost-per-token and a regression flag when integrity drops more than 2% absolute for a given latency improvement
Integrate key metrics into the console eval dashboard and add an alert rule that correlates config rollouts with integrity regressions
Document recommended safe-config ranges per model family and provide a canary rollout playbook for Dedicated/Private deployments
test_matrix: Sweep grid: packing_delay_ms = [0,5,10,25,50]; microbatch_cap = [1,2,4,8]; kv_ttl_secs = [0,15,60,300]; prefix_merge = [off, on]; models = [rw-13b, rw-33b-quant, open-7b]; request_slices = [short-avg20, medium-avg120, long-avg800]
plan_steps: Prototype harness using existing batch-sweeper infra (ENG-214512) and extend to parameterize packing_delay and microbatch_cap
Implement lightweight integrity scorer combining embedding similarity to golden answers and heuristic hallucination signals; provide CI artifact for offline scoring
Run small-scale sweeps on a staging GPU pool to validate stability and runtime bookkeeping
Scale full-grid runs on Dedicated reservable pool overnight, persist outputs to eval-bucket and load into viz pipeline
Annotate slices where integrity vs latency contours are non-monotonic and add as special-case alerts
Document recommended default profiles and add automated rollback logic to rollout playbook
monitoring: Push integrity and latency timeseries to console eval dashboard under tile 'packing-x-ttl frontier'; configure regression alert: integrity_drop_absolute >= 0.02 AND p95_latency_improvement >= 0.20 within 24h of config rollout
rollout: Stage: run smoke sweep in staging for each model family
Canary: expose new packing profile to 5% of traffic with detailed logging and integrity scoring
Ramp: if no alerts for 48h, increase to 25%, then 100% after 7 days
Rollback: automatic rollback if integrity alert fires or if tail_spike_count increases by >150%
